name: 128字阈值/分数寄存器与并行比较器：7top/84PT窗口
boundary: 128-word bank + write decode + actual ICG; comparator variants add 128 parallel unsigned LT, external random input. No LUT/FP converter/max/RNG/arbiter/V/CTS/SPEF/SDF.

conditions.activity: Synthetic Python PRNG, thresholds uniform [0,0.5] with boundaries; zero-delay gate VCD averaged PT

source.binding: v5 final manifest; five completed v4 cases, v3 proof reuse and v5 partial continuation recorded per-case; old immutable archives retained

limitations: Prelayout zero-delay mapped VCD; no CTS/SPEF/SDF or complete glitch model. Power not silicon measurement.
16-bit gated banks hold=-0.010220 ns at wr_data input; 12-bit margin only +0.004787 ns. SS only, not physical signoff.
Both comparator variants retain 256 low-ramp table extrapolations per window. No missing power tables/functions; gate root slew corrected.
Synthetic three-seed thresholds/random words, not measured Qwen activity; no new model/PPL conclusion.
No FP conversion/max/LUT/RNG/arbiter/address map/V/accumulation. Random source and clock/data distribution upstream are not free.
Score bank is an optional simultaneously retained staging buffer; its scheduling/removal requires separate proof. All-layer area multiplication only for physical replication.
next_action: Close 16-bit input hold and comparator low-ramp extrapolation with physical interface; integrate measured-throughput LUT and qualified RNG before total Ising comparison
